S.10 KPI defensibility disciplines

Every KPI above carries three defensibility disciplines that Deloitte delivery builds in:

  1. Baseline established in Wave 1. Before agents deploy, baseline measurement methodology is agreed with the client. No "it was always like this" arguments later.
  2. Attribution mechanism. Every KPI uplift traces to specific agent decisions through APEX audit row. CFO's FP&A team can query the attribution path.
  3. Confounding-factor management. Concurrent initiatives that could influence KPIs are inventoried; measurement accounts for them. Deloitte Commercial QR reviews attribution methodology for value-share arrangements.

S.11 KPI conversation discipline for sellers

  • Never quote a specific number to a client without the conditional language ("typical range is," "reference clients at similar scale saw...")
  • Always ground in client's own baseline — commit only after Wave 1 envisioning measures the client's actual starting state
  • Offer ranges, not points — avoid false precision; stretch-conservative-realistic trio
  • Frame attribution explicitly — "this KPI will be measured by [specific audit-row query] with [specific confounding factor] controlled"
  • Match to the buyer — CFOs get dollar KPIs; COOs get cycle-time; frontline leaders get time-returned
  • Never use a competitor's KPI — "Accenture told us +X%" is not a Deloitte commitment
Independence Reminder

Independence Reminder. KPI ranges are illustrative and based on Deloitte's aggregated delivery experience. Specific client commitments go through Deloitte Commercial QR review. Value-share arrangements with KPI-linked fees require additional Independence and Risk sign-off.

Appendix T

Orchestration Catalog — Per Schema

This appendix is the seller's and architect's reference catalog of orchestrations Deloitte delivers across APEX Practices. Each orchestration entry specifies description, schemas used, action invoked, data consumed, HITL pattern, and trigger. Organized by Practice → Schema. Cross-reference §6.9 for the orchestration deep-dive, §12.9 for the AXLE framework's 10 automotive orchestrations, and §1.6 for canonical-schema acceleration context.

T.1 How to read this catalog

Each orchestration uses a standard 6-field template:

  • Description — 2-3 sentences on what the orchestration accomplishes
  • Primary schema / Related schemas — canonical schemas the orchestration operates on
  • Action invoked — the downstream state change(s) triggered post-HITL
  • Data used — Gold views and key entities queried during execution
  • HITL pattern — where human approval gates insert
  • Trigger — event or condition that fires the orchestration

Orchestration IDs follow the pattern [PRACTICE]-[SCHEMA]-ORCH-[NN]. E.g., RC-SCML-ORCH-03 is the third orchestration pattern for RC Practice's SCML schema.

For orchestrations that reuse one of the 47 APEX archetypes, the archetype is noted. Many orchestrations specialise the same archetype across Practices — recall-trigger patterns, pattern-match-to-HITL patterns, continuous-monitor-to-alert patterns all have cross-Practice parallels.

T.2 Retail & Consumer (RC) Practice orchestrations

T.2.1 SCML (Supply Chain Merchandising) orchestrations

RC-SCML-ORCH-01 Cold-Chain Excursion Response

  • Description. Detect refrigeration excursion, classify affected inventory by food-safety thresholds, produce save/destroy disposition, route write-off pre-approval, ticket vendor with telemetry evidence, emit regulator-ready audit.
  • Primary schema. SCML (Inventory Position, Lot); related MERML (Price for at-risk valuation).
  • Action invoked. Inventory disposition (save/destroy), write-off posting, vendor ticket, quarantine task assignment.
  • Data used. Cold-chain telemetry (Eventhouse), SCML Lot, SCML Inventory Position, SCML SKU with sub-category classification for FDA rules.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate on write-off approval (Store Ops Lead).
  • Trigger. Temperature-threshold breach sustained beyond duration policy.
  • Archetype. Continuous-Monitor Threshold + HITL-Alert.

RC-SCML-ORCH-02 Inbound Receiving Discrepancy + Dispute

  • Description. Compare RFID/scanner actuals to ASN + invoice; identify variance; pull vendor 90-day history; draft dispute package with timestamped evidence; stage for manager sign at dock.
  • Primary schema. SCML (Shipment, Supplier); related SCML Lot (for item-level detail).
  • Action invoked. Dispute claim filing, vendor performance-signal update, receipt-flag for downstream reconciliation.
  • Data used. ASN, receiving events, DSD invoice, vendor history, portal/dock-camera metadata.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate at dispute sign-off (Store Ops Lead).
  • Trigger. Portal scan variance exceeding tolerance vs ASN.
  • Archetype. Pattern-Detection + Investigation-Package Assembly.

RC-SCML-ORCH-03 Phantom OOS Detection + Pick Assignment

  • Description. Fuse shelf-CV, POS velocity, and perpetual inventory to confirm phantom OOS; generate planogram-ordered pick list; assign task to most-available associate.
  • Primary schema. SCML (Inventory Position, SKU); related MERML (Assortment, for planogram).
  • Action invoked. Associate task dispatch via Me@Store; inventory-record correction if variance confirmed.
  • Data used. Shelf CV events, 4-hour POS velocity, perpetual inventory, planogram, associate status/zone.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate (Store Ops Lead acknowledges pattern).
  • Trigger. Shelf-CV empty-facing detection sustained with non-zero perpetual inventory.
  • Archetype. Continuous-Monitor Threshold + HITL-Alert (multi-source fusion variant).

RC-SCML-ORCH-04 FSMA-204 Recall Impact Resolution

  • Description. On FDA recall notice: resolve upstream Lot → Supplier → Shipment → Store; enumerate on-shelf + backroom + sold units; identify loyalty-buyers of sold units; draft customer notifications; assemble quarantine plan; post POS block; preserve FSMA-204 audit trail. (See §16.13.6 Store 100 Event 05.)
  • Primary schema. SCML (Lot, Shipment, Supplier, Inventory Position); related CXML (Customer for loyalty resolution, Transaction for sold-unit trace).
  • Action invoked. Quarantine execution, bilingual customer notification (email + SMS), POS regulatory hold, FSMA-204 evidence package.
  • Data used. SCML Lot lineage, CXML Customer (loyalty-identified), CXML Transaction, MERML Price for recall-value computation.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Store Ops Lead + Corporate Comms approve before customer notification release).
  • Trigger. FDA recall notice posted; RFR detection via monitored FDA feed.
  • Archetype. "Regulatory-triggered multi-stakeholder response with mandatory HITL and audit-preservation."

RC-SCML-ORCH-05 Supplier Performance Anomaly

  • Description. Aggregate supplier performance signals (OTIF, chargeback, quality holds, variance patterns); identify anomalies exceeding cohort baseline; route to supplier-development team for action.
  • Primary schema. SCML (Supplier, Shipment, Lot).
  • Action invoked. Supplier-flag escalation, Merchant-escalation notification, contract-review trigger.
  • Data used. Supplier Performance Window (Pattern C Gold), historical baseline, cohort comparisons.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate on Merchant-escalation (supplier-development manager).
  • Trigger. Nightly supplier-performance pattern detection run.
  • Archetype. Pattern-Detection + Investigation-Package Assembly.

RC-SCML-ORCH-06 Cross-Store Inventory Rebalance

  • Description. Detect stores overstocked on fast-movers while peer stores are understocked; propose inter-store transfers optimized against freight + handling cost; stage as transfer plan.
  • Primary schema. SCML (Inventory Position, Store, SKU); related MERML (Price for margin-protection valuation).
  • Action invoked. Inter-store transfer order creation after HITL approval.
  • Data used. Inventory position cross-store snapshot, demand signals (MERML), cluster definitions.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Regional Operations or designated supply coordinator).
  • Trigger. Nightly imbalance detection + threshold crossing.
  • Archetype. Real-Time Concurrent-Optimization.

RC-SCML-ORCH-07 BOPIS Substitution Recommendation

  • Description. When BOPIS picker hits OOS: retrieve customer 14-month substitution history; rank candidate substitutes; push one-tap SMS confirmation; advance fulfillment.
  • Primary schema. SCML (Inventory Position) + CXML (Customer, Preference); related MERML (Price for value-equivalence).
  • Action invoked. SMS to customer with one-tap confirm; fulfillment-status advance on confirm.
  • Data used. CXML Customer with substitution history, SCML current Inventory Position, MERML Price for equivalence check.
  • HITL pattern. Zero-touch manager (fully autonomous); customer consent is the "HITL" via one-tap.
  • Trigger. Pick exception during BOPIS order execution.
  • Archetype. Real-Time Concurrent-Optimization (preference-matched).

RC-SCML-ORCH-08 Lot-Level Sustainability Attestation

  • Description. On sustainability claim dispute or audit request, assemble lot-level provenance package covering supplier attestation, manufacturing conditions, recycled-content percentage, and chain-of-custody evidence.
  • Primary schema. SCML (Lot, Supplier, Shipment).
  • Action invoked. Evidence package generation for legal/journalist/regulator response.
  • Data used. SCML Lot Genealogy (Pattern D federated view), supplier attestations, third-party verification feeds.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Chief Sustainability Officer or designated counsel review before release).
  • Trigger. Inbound inquiry OR scheduled quarterly audit preparation.
  • Archetype. Scope-Computation + Tiered-Response (evidence-assembly variant).

T.2.2 MERML (Merchandising) orchestrations

RC-MERML-ORCH-01 Margin-Exposure Detection + Category Response

  • Description. Monitor category-level margin against competitor pricing, supplier-cost moves, and promotional calendar; flag margin-exposure with root cause; recommend category-level action (re-price, re-promo, assortment shift).
  • Primary schema. MERML (Category, Price, Promotion, Competitive Signal); related SCML (SKU, Supplier).
  • Action invoked. Price-change proposal, promotion adjustment, or assortment-review flag post-HITL.
  • Data used. MERML category rollup, Price history, Competitive Signal, MERML Promotion performance.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Chief Merchant or delegated category manager).
  • Trigger. Daily category-margin review; or competitive-move trigger.
  • Archetype. Continuous-Monitor Threshold + HITL-Alert.

RC-MERML-ORCH-02 ESL Sync Failure + Loss Prevention

  • Description. On detected POS-vs-shelf price divergence: suspend stale override at register; print paper tags to bridge; ticket ESL vendor with time-series evidence.
  • Primary schema. MERML (Price, Promotion Activation).
  • Action invoked. POS override suspension, paper-tag print job, ESL vendor ticket.
  • Data used. Price Record state vs actual POS rings, ESL gateway sync telemetry.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate (Store Ops Lead acknowledges paper-tag execution).
  • Trigger. POS ring of promo price on SKU with scheduled regular price.

RC-MERML-ORCH-03 Markdown Cadence Optimisation

  • Description. For seasonal/aged inventory: evaluate sell-through against markdown schedule; recommend next cadence step (deepen, hold, clear); emit at SKU-store granularity.
  • Primary schema. MERML (Markdown, Price, Promotion); related SCML (Inventory Position).
  • Action invoked. Markdown-step execution (price change) after HITL approval.
  • Data used. Markdown state history, sell-through velocity, remaining inventory position, seasonal pattern.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate at category level; batched approvals for efficiency.
  • Trigger. Scheduled cadence review (typically daily for active markdown programs).

RC-MERML-ORCH-04 Competitive-Response Pattern Detection

  • Description. Monitor competitor pricing / promo / assortment moves; classify move type (promotional vs permanent vs category-wide); generate recommended response per corporate policy.
  • Primary schema. MERML (Competitive Signal, Price, Promotion, Assortment).
  • Action invoked. Recommendation package to category team; no automatic price change.
  • Data used. Third-party competitive intelligence, internal Price, current Promotion state, assortment overlap.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (category merchant); policy-gate available for auto-match scenarios.
  • Trigger. Continuous competitive-signal monitoring with move-detection threshold.

RC-MERML-ORCH-05 Assortment Gap Detection

  • Description. Identify SKUs selling above expected in stores where they are NOT in assortment (implied demand); recommend assortment additions with expected lift and cannibalization analysis.
  • Primary schema. MERML (Assortment, Category); related SCML (SKU, Store), CXML (Transaction patterns).
  • Action invoked. Assortment-change proposal post-HITL.
  • Data used. Cross-store Transaction patterns, Assortment cluster definitions, SKU velocity.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (category merchant); pilot-test gate typical before full rollout.
  • Trigger. Monthly assortment-review cycle.

RC-MERML-ORCH-06 Promotion Lift Attribution + Post-Mortem

  • Description. Post-promotion: compute attributable lift isolating baseline demand, cannibalization, and halo effects; produce ROI package for trade-promotion-management review.
  • Primary schema. MERML (Promotion, Price); related CXML (Transaction), SCML (Inventory Position).
  • Action invoked. Trade-promo-effectiveness update; vendor-fund claim adjustment.
  • Data used. Pre/during/post-promo Transaction patterns, baseline demand model, related-SKU Transaction for halo/cannibalization.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate (trade-promo manager review; escalates to CFO for large-value claims).
  • Trigger. Promotion-end + attribution-window completion.

RC-MERML-ORCH-07 Competitive-Assortment Gap Alert

  • Description. Detect categories where competitors have assortment breadth that we lack, and we are losing share per third-party measurement; generate category-review package.
  • Primary schema. MERML (Competitive Signal, Assortment).
  • Action invoked. Category-review flag with evidence package.
  • Data used. NielsenIQ/Circana competitive assortment data, internal assortment comparison.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Chief Merchant or VP Category).
  • Trigger. Monthly competitive-intelligence data refresh.

T.2.3 CXML (Customer Experience) orchestrations

RC-CXML-ORCH-01 Customer Identity Resolution

  • Description. On ambiguous customer identifier: probabilistic + deterministic match across source systems; produce canonical customer ID with confidence score and evidence trail; route low-confidence matches to HITL.
  • Primary schema. CXML (Customer, Identity).
  • Action invoked. Canonical-customer-ID assignment or ambiguity flag.
  • Data used. Source-system identity records, historical merge decisions, evidence patterns.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for high-confidence; hard gate for ambiguous (loyalty-ops specialist).
  • Trigger. Identity inquiry or new-source-record ingestion with unresolved identifiers.

RC-CXML-ORCH-02 Next-Best-Action Recommendation

  • Description. For active customer interaction: synthesize 14-month behavior, loyalty status, preferences, open service cases; produce ranked NBA list appropriate to channel and moment.
  • Primary schema. CXML (Customer, Interaction, Loyalty Member, Preference).
  • Action invoked. NBA surfaced to channel (email, SMS, app, associate device).
  • Data used. Customer 360 Gold, recent Interactions, active campaign-eligibility rules.
  • HITL pattern. Typically zero-touch for standard NBAs; policy-gate for high-value offers.
  • Trigger. Customer session start, service contact, scheduled campaign.

RC-CXML-ORCH-03 Customer Incident Pattern Detection

  • Description. Aggregate customer complaints/incidents by product, lot, issue-type; detect emerging patterns across stores; escalate tier-2+ cases pre-emptively before external pattern emerges. (See §16.13.9 Store 100 Event 08.)
  • Primary schema. CXML (Customer Incident, Customer, Transaction); related SCML (Lot).
  • Action invoked. Tier-classification + cross-store proactive-pull trigger for potential systemic issues; QA/Legal/Comms notification.
  • Data used. CXML Customer Incident history, SCML Lot Genealogy, Transaction timeline.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (QA lead + Legal counsel for proactive pull decisions).
  • Trigger. Customer service desk incident creation + threshold-pattern detection.
  • Archetype. "Pattern-match on event cluster → regulatory-scope compute → multi-stakeholder notification."

RC-CXML-ORCH-04 Loyalty-Member Retention Intervention

  • Description. Detect at-risk loyalty members (declining engagement, tier downgrade imminent, negative interaction pattern); generate personalized retention offer; execute and track response.
  • Primary schema. CXML (Loyalty Member, Customer, Interaction, Transaction).
  • Action invoked. Targeted offer delivery via preferred channel; loyalty-credit issuance on acceptance.
  • Data used. Loyalty-value-trend model, recent Interaction sentiment, offer-eligibility rules.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for standard offers; hard gate for high-value customer tier.
  • Trigger. Daily at-risk detection; or immediate on sentiment-threshold-crossing event.

RC-CXML-ORCH-05 Service-Case Intelligence + Routing

  • Description. New customer service case: classify intent, retrieve prior history, pre-populate case metadata, route to appropriate specialist; draft suggested response for agent review.
  • Primary schema. CXML (Customer, Interaction, Preference).
  • Action invoked. Case-creation in service system; routing to specialist queue; draft response pre-staged.
  • Data used. Customer 360, prior cases, knowledge-base articles, policy rules.
  • HITL pattern. Zero-touch for routing; agent-assist HITL on response (Copilot Studio surface).
  • Trigger. Inbound customer contact (call, chat, email, social).

RC-CXML-ORCH-06 Member-Value Uplift Campaign Design

  • Description. Segment loyalty members by value trajectory; design per-segment test-and-learn offer; execute and measure incremental lift; feed outcomes back to next-campaign design.
  • Primary schema. CXML (Loyalty Member, Customer, Transaction).
  • Action invoked. Campaign execution across segments; A/B test tracking.
  • Data used. Member LTV trajectory, historical response rates by segment.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Loyalty Director) on campaign execution; policy gate on within-band offer values.
  • Trigger. Scheduled campaign cycle + trajectory-threshold detection.

RC-CXML-ORCH-07 Session Abandonment Recovery

  • Description. Detect meaningful cart/session abandonment (vs routine browse); produce personalized recovery message timed optimally for customer segment.
  • Primary schema. CXML (Session, Customer, Preference).
  • Action invoked. Abandonment-recovery message via customer-preferred channel.
  • Data used. Session state, abandonment patterns by cohort, deliverability metrics.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within-band messages auto-execute; high-value or novel-offer escalates).
  • Trigger. Session-inactivity threshold crossed with meaningful-cart signal.

T.3 Healthcare & Life Sciences (HLS) Practice orchestrations

T.3.1 Payer (MemberML, ClaimML, UtilizationML) orchestrations

HLS-PAYER-ORCH-01 Prior-Authorization Decision

  • Description. On auth request: evaluate clinical appropriateness against guidelines, retrieve member history, check contract scope, apply policy rules; emit decision recommendation (approve / pend-for-info / deny with rationale).
  • Primary schema. UtilizationML (Authorization, UM Case); related MemberML, ClaimML, ProviderContract.
  • Action invoked. Authorization decision issuance post-HITL (medical director for non-routine).
  • Data used. Authorization submission, Member 360, prior Claim history, clinical guideline library, Provider Contract.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for routine approvals; hard gate (medical director) for non-routine / denial cases.
  • Trigger. Prior-authorization request submission via provider portal.
  • Archetype. "Clinical-guideline evaluation + policy-rule application + HITL medical decision."

HLS-PAYER-ORCH-02 Claim Denial Risk Prediction (Pre-Submission Alert)

  • Description. Evaluate submitted claim pre-adjudication; predict likelihood of denial per payer-pattern library; flag documentation insufficiency; recommend corrections before claim finalisation.
  • Primary schema. ClaimML (Claim); related UtilizationML (Authorization), ProviderContract.
  • Action invoked. Denial-risk alert to revenue-cycle team; recommended-correction package.
  • Data used. Claim draft, historical denial patterns for payer, Provider Contract specifics.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate (revenue-cycle specialist action on alerts; no system block on submission).
  • Trigger. Claim submission event.

HLS-PAYER-ORCH-03 Member Care-Gap Closure

  • Description. Identify members with active Stars / HEDIS care gaps; produce outreach list prioritized by gap severity + member response-likelihood + payer-incentive value; coordinate outreach execution.
  • Primary schema. MemberML (Member, Care Gap); related ClaimML.
  • Action invoked. Multi-channel outreach (preferred channel) with scheduling assistance.
  • Data used. Member care-gap inventory, historical response rates, outreach-channel preferences.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate (Care-management manager approves campaign; individual executions automated).
  • Trigger. Daily care-gap inventory refresh + campaign-scheduling cycle.

HLS-PAYER-ORCH-04 UM Case Aggregation + Specialist Coordination

  • Description. Collect related authorizations + claims + clinical context into single UM Case; coordinate specialist consults; track case progression against care-plan milestones.
  • Primary schema. UtilizationML (UM Case, Authorization); related MemberML (Member), ClaimML.
  • Action invoked. Specialist-consult scheduling, care-plan-milestone tracking, member communication.
  • Data used. UM Case state, Member 360, open Authorizations, prior clinical events.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate at specialist-consult decisions; case-manager owns routine progression.
  • Trigger. UM Case creation or status-change event.

HLS-PAYER-ORCH-05 Fraud-Waste-Abuse (FWA) Pattern Detection

  • Description. Detect anomalous claim patterns (high-utilization outliers, unusual procedure-combinations, provider-behavior shifts); produce investigation package with statistical evidence.
  • Primary schema. ClaimML (Claim); related ProviderContract.
  • Action invoked. FWA investigation case creation; pre-payment hold for high-confidence cases.
  • Data used. Claim history, provider-pattern baselines, peer-cohort comparisons.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (FWA investigator) before pre-payment hold; policy gate for low-severity flags.
  • Trigger. Continuous claim-stream pattern detection + threshold crossing.

HLS-PAYER-ORCH-06 Provider Network Adequacy Monitoring

  • Description. Evaluate member access to contracted providers across specialties, geographies, and time-to-appointment; detect emerging adequacy gaps; recommend network-addition priorities.
  • Primary schema. MemberML (Member); related ProviderContract.
  • Action invoked. Network-gap evidence package for Contracting team.
  • Data used. Member geographic distribution, ProviderContract roster with availability, appointment-access data.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Contracting director) before network-expansion initiation.
  • Trigger. Monthly adequacy review + member-access-complaint trigger.

HLS-PAYER-ORCH-07 Risk-Adjustment Coding Quality

  • Description. Review submitted diagnosis-code patterns against member clinical evidence; flag potential under-coding or over-coding; produce correction workflow for coding team.
  • Primary schema. ClaimML (Claim), MemberML (Member).
  • Action invoked. Coding-correction workflow assignment; provider-education flag for patterns.
  • Data used. Claim diagnosis codes, member clinical evidence, risk-score calculations.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (coding specialist validates corrections before submission).
  • Trigger. Scheduled coding-quality review cycle.

HLS-PAYER-ORCH-08 Member Complaint + Grievance Resolution

  • Description. On member grievance submission: classify complaint type, retrieve relevant member + claim + authorization history, draft response, route to appropriate resolution specialist.
  • Primary schema. MemberML (Member); related ClaimML, UtilizationML.
  • Action invoked. Case creation in grievance system with pre-staged evidence; draft response for specialist review.
  • Data used. Member 360, related Claims, prior Authorizations, grievance-precedent library.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (grievance specialist approves response before member-facing delivery).
  • Trigger. Grievance submission event.

T.3.2 Provider (PatientML, EncounterML, OrderML) orchestrations

HLS-PROV-ORCH-01 Clinical Documentation Assist

  • Description. During patient encounter: real-time speech-to-text with clinical grounding; draft progress note, discharge summary, or consultation doc aligned to documentation requirements; preserve physician voice and clinical nuance.
  • Primary schema. EncounterML (Encounter, Clinical Note); related PatientML.
  • Action invoked. Draft note creation for physician review; auto-population of structured fields.
  • Data used. Real-time encounter transcript, Patient 360, encounter-type documentation requirements.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (physician signs note; nothing auto-commits).
  • Trigger. Encounter start with documentation-assist opt-in.

HLS-PROV-ORCH-02 Duplicate Order Prevention

  • Description. On order entry: detect duplicate or near-duplicate with pending/recent orders; surface to ordering clinician with context; allow dismiss with reason.
  • Primary schema. OrderML (Order); related PatientML, EncounterML.
  • Action invoked. In-CPOE alert with one-click dismiss/proceed/review; dismissal reason captured.
  • Data used. Patient Order history, pending Order queue.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (physician decision; dismissal logged for quality analysis).
  • Trigger. Order sign attempt in CPOE.

HLS-PROV-ORCH-03 Sepsis Early-Warning

  • Description. Continuous monitoring of vital-sign + medication + lab trajectory; predictive risk scoring; classification against sepsis patterns; clinician alert on high-confidence threshold. (See §10.9.4 hospital narrative.)
  • Primary schema. PatientML (Patient); related EncounterML, OrderML.
  • Action invoked. Clinician alert with pattern explanation + recommended bundle; rapid-response team notification on severe signals.
  • Data used. Continuous vitals stream (Eventhouse), medication administration events, recent labs, clinical pattern library.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (charge nurse assesses + pages hospitalist; hospitalist orders bundle).
  • Trigger. Continuous monitoring with threshold-crossing + evaluator confidence.
  • Archetype. "Continuous-monitoring + pattern-match + HITL-expert-confirmation + protocol-initiation."

HLS-PROV-ORCH-04 Denial Prevention Pre-Submission

  • Description. Pre-submission claim review: identify documentation gaps, medical-necessity risks, coding issues; recommend additions/corrections before claim leaves.
  • Primary schema. EncounterML (Encounter, Clinical Note); related OrderML, PatientML.
  • Action invoked. Physician alert with suggested addendum text; coding-team review flag if systemic.
  • Data used. Encounter documentation, payer-specific denial patterns, prior denials on similar encounters.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate (physician addendum optional; revenue-cycle team sees unresolved flags).
  • Trigger. Discharge-planning milestone; pre-billing review stage.

HLS-PROV-ORCH-05 Patient-Deterioration Composite Scoring

  • Description. Beyond sepsis — composite scoring across deterioration patterns (cardiac, respiratory, neurological); hierarchical orchestration with pattern-specialist specialists.
  • Primary schema. PatientML (Patient); related EncounterML, OrderML.
  • Action invoked. Alert tier per severity; rapid-response activation on critical.
  • Data used. Continuous vitals, medication events, lab trends, encounter context.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate per severity tier (nurse → hospitalist → rapid-response team).
  • Trigger. Continuous monitoring with multi-pattern evaluator.

HLS-PROV-ORCH-06 Discharge Planning Coordination

  • Description. On discharge-ready signal: coordinate across case management, social work, transport, receiving facility, family notification, medication reconciliation; present unified package for case manager.
  • Primary schema. EncounterML (Encounter); related PatientML, OrderML.
  • Action invoked. Parallel-coordinated scheduling (SNF bed, DME, transport); family notification; medication-reconciliation package.
  • Data used. Encounter state, care-team assignments, external-facility availability, insurance-coverage check.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (case manager approves discharge package; physician orders final).
  • Trigger. Discharge-ready clinical event.

HLS-PROV-ORCH-07 Order-Set Recommendation

  • Description. On encounter context and clinical decision: recommend evidence-based order-set consistent with institutional protocols; explain rationale and evidence basis.
  • Primary schema. OrderML (Order); related EncounterML, PatientML.
  • Action invoked. Order-set pre-populated in CPOE for physician review.
  • Data used. Encounter diagnosis, Patient history, evidence-based protocol library, institutional customisations.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (physician reviews, modifies, signs).
  • Trigger. Clinical context signaling protocol-appropriate decision.

HLS-PROV-ORCH-08 Pharmacy Inventory Reallocation

  • Description. Detect approaching-expiry high-cost drug; query cross-facility demand for remaining shelf life; draft transfer plan; route for pharmacy-director approval.
  • Primary schema. OrderML (Order); related PatientML.
  • Action invoked. Inter-facility pharmacy transfer with pedigree documentation.
  • Data used. Pharmacy inventory by facility, patient-schedule demand forecasts, drug pedigree chain.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (pharmacy director).
  • Trigger. Daily expiry-window detection + cross-facility demand check.

T.3.3 Life Sciences (StudyML, RWEML, HCPML) orchestrations

HLS-LS-ORCH-01 Real-World Evidence Signal Detection

  • Description. Scan RWE cohort data for statistical signals (efficacy, safety, utilization) meeting significance thresholds; produce investigation package with methodology and preliminary evidence.
  • Primary schema. RWEML (RWE Cohort, Signal); related StudyML.
  • Action invoked. Formal signal-investigation case creation with evidence package.
  • Data used. RWE Cohort data, historical comparable-signal precedents, medical-affairs review framework.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (medical-affairs lead) before formal investigation.
  • Trigger. Scheduled RWE signal-detection run.

HLS-LS-ORCH-02 Study Site Selection

  • Description. For new trial: evaluate site candidates across feasibility, historical enrollment, quality, principal-investigator experience, patient population fit; produce ranked site list with rationale.
  • Primary schema. StudyML (Study, Site).
  • Action invoked. Site-ranking package for study-operations review.
  • Data used. Site-history, Principal Investigator history, patient-population data, feasibility surveys.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (study-operations director) before site activation.
  • Trigger. New study feasibility phase initiation.

HLS-LS-ORCH-03 Subject Enrollment Forecasting

  • Description. Per active study: forecast enrollment trajectory at each site; identify lagging sites; recommend corrective action (additional screening, site coaching, alternative-site activation).
  • Primary schema. StudyML (Study, Subject, Site).
  • Action invoked. Site-coaching alert or alternative-site activation trigger.
  • Data used. Subject Enrollment history, Site performance, Study milestones.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (clinical-operations) on corrective actions.
  • Trigger. Weekly enrollment-trajectory review.

HLS-LS-ORCH-04 HCP Segmentation + Next-Best-Action

  • Description. Dynamic HCP segmentation based on prescribing pattern, engagement history, digital behavior, specialty focus; recommend NBA per HCP for commercial / MSL team.
  • Primary schema. HCPML (HCP, Engagement).
  • Action invoked. NBA delivery to field rep (CRM suggestion) or MSL (Veeva-integration).
  • Data used. HCP 360, Engagement history, Prescribing patterns, Congress data.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within-band NBAs auto-suggest; high-value KOL engagements go to manager).
  • Trigger. Field-rep call-planning cycle or event-triggered insight.

HLS-LS-ORCH-05 Protocol Deviation Detection

  • Description. Monitor trial-conduct data for deviations from protocol; classify severity; notify responsible parties with context.
  • Primary schema. StudyML (Study, Subject, Protocol Deviation).
  • Action invoked. Site-notification with deviation context; CRO/sponsor alert for material deviations.
  • Data used. Subject visit data, protocol specifications, historical-deviation patterns.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (clinical-ops) on material-deviation response; soft gate on routine.
  • Trigger. Continuous trial-conduct data review.

HLS-LS-ORCH-06 Commercial Effectiveness Attribution

  • Description. Attribute prescribing changes to specific commercial/MSL engagement touchpoints; produce per-HCP effectiveness reports for commercial-leadership review.
  • Primary schema. HCPML (HCP, Engagement); related StudyML outputs.
  • Action invoked. Effectiveness-attribution package for commercial leadership.
  • Data used. Engagement timeline, Prescribing data, Competitor-activity context.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate (commercial lead review).
  • Trigger. Quarterly commercial-effectiveness cycle.

HLS-LS-ORCH-07 Pipeline Portfolio Prioritization

  • Description. Multi-criteria scoring of pipeline programs against scientific promise, commercial attractiveness, competitive landscape, regulatory pathway; produce prioritisation recommendation for portfolio committee.
  • Primary schema. StudyML (Study pipeline); related RWEML.
  • Action invoked. Portfolio-prioritisation package for exec-committee review.
  • Data used. Pipeline program status, internal + external intelligence, competitor programs.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (portfolio committee ultimate decision).
  • Trigger. Semi-annual portfolio review cycle.

T.4 Energy & Resources (ER) Practice orchestrations

T.4.1 Upstream Oil & Gas (AssetML, WellML, ProcessML) orchestrations

ER-UOG-ORCH-01 Well Production Decline Intervention

  • Description. Monitor per-well production against type-curve; detect accelerating decline or lifting-efficiency loss; recommend workover candidate (pump change, acid-stim, sand-control) with economic evaluation.
  • Primary schema. WellML (Well, Production Event); related AssetML.
  • Action invoked. Workover recommendation package for production-engineering review.
  • Data used. Production time-series, type-curve model, artificial-lift parameters, economic model.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (production engineer + reservoir engineer) before workover authorization.
  • Trigger. Continuous production monitoring with decline-threshold crossing.

ER-UOG-ORCH-02 Predictive Maintenance Dispatch

  • Description. On asset-health-score degradation (pump, compressor, separator): predict time-to-failure; optimize maintenance-window against production impact; schedule with parts + technician availability.
  • Primary schema. AssetML (Asset); related ProcessML.
  • Action invoked. Work-order creation with scheduled window; parts-reservation; technician assignment.
  • Data used. Asset telemetry, historian-derived health model, parts-inventory, technician-schedule.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for routine; hard gate (maintenance manager) for production-impacting.
  • Trigger. Health-score threshold + RUL estimate crossing.

ER-UOG-ORCH-03 Process Excursion Response

  • Description. Detect DCS/PLC excursion (setpoint deviation, safety-margin breach); classify severity; recommend operator action or automated alarm escalation.
  • Primary schema. ProcessML (Process Step); related AssetML.
  • Action invoked. Operator alert with context; safety-system verification; engineering-escalation if persistent.
  • Data used. Process-control telemetry, setpoint history, safety-limit definitions.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (control-room operator) on setpoint changes; autonomous monitoring only.
  • Trigger. Excursion detection exceeding tolerance.

ER-UOG-ORCH-04 Flaring / Emissions Event Management

  • Description. Real-time flaring event detection; classify cause (upset, scheduled, blowdown); document for regulatory reporting; recommend mitigation for recurring patterns.
  • Primary schema. ProcessML (Process Step); related AssetML.
  • Action invoked. Regulatory-reporting entry creation; maintenance-review flag on recurring patterns.
  • Data used. Flaring-stack telemetry, operational-events, weather (for atmospheric-dispersion context).
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (environmental-compliance lead) on regulatory entries.
  • Trigger. Flaring event detection.

ER-UOG-ORCH-05 Artificial-Lift Optimization

  • Description. Per-well artificial-lift tuning based on production rate, fluid properties, pump parameters; recommend setpoint changes for sustained efficiency.
  • Primary schema. WellML (Well); related AssetML, ProcessML.
  • Action invoked. Setpoint change recommendation for production engineer review.
  • Data used. Lift parameters, production rate, fluid-characterization.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (production engineer).
  • Trigger. Weekly optimization cycle + event-triggered review.

ER-UOG-ORCH-06 Production Accounting Reconciliation

  • Description. Nightly reconciliation between SCADA-measured production and allocation records; detect variance; investigate patterns; update allocations post-review.
  • Primary schema. WellML (Production Event).
  • Action invoked. Allocation-adjustment workflow for accounting review; investigation-flag on persistent variance.
  • Data used. SCADA-derived production, current allocation, custody-transfer meter data.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (production accountant) on allocation changes.
  • Trigger. Nightly reconciliation job.

T.4.2 Power & Utilities (GridML, OutageML, MeterML) orchestrations

ER-PU-ORCH-01 Outage Restoration Sequencing

  • Description. On outage event: correlate SCADA + AMI + OMS; enumerate affected customers with criticality classification; optimize restoration sequence against crew position + repair complexity; communicate ETRs.
  • Primary schema. OutageML (Outage Event); related GridML (Grid Asset), MeterML.
  • Action invoked. Crew-dispatch instructions; customer-communication (ETR + status).
  • Data used. SCADA fault indicators, AMI last-gasp signals, topology, customer criticality registry, crew locations.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (dispatcher) on restoration sequence + crew assignments.
  • Trigger. Outage-event creation in OMS.

ER-PU-ORCH-02 Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) Decision

  • Description. On red-flag fire conditions: compute wildfire-risk score combining fuel load + weather + asset state + customer count; assemble de-energization proposal with regulatory-reporting package.
  • Primary schema. GridML (Grid Asset, Wildfire Risk Zone); related OutageML.
  • Action invoked. PSPS initiation on feeder(s) post-approval; customer communication; media statement.
  • Data used. Wildfire-risk model, weather forecast, asset vulnerability, customer-impact calculation.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (operations director + CEO per utility protocol); regulator notification required.
  • Trigger. Red-flag conditions + wildfire-risk-threshold crossing.
  • Archetype. "Safety-critical multi-stakeholder approval with regulator trail."

ER-PU-ORCH-03 DER Orchestration for Grid Support

  • Description. On grid-constraint signal (peak demand, reserve shortage): signal DER dispatch to enrolled customers; compute per-customer contribution; handle settlement post-event.
  • Primary schema. GridML (DER Unit); related MeterML.
  • Action invoked. DER dispatch signals; settlement records post-event.
  • Data used. DER-unit availability, customer enrollment, real-time grid state, settlement rules.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within enrolled scope); hard gate (market-operator) for extraordinary dispatches.
  • Trigger. Grid-state signal crossing.

ER-PU-ORCH-04 Vegetation Management Pre-Emptive Clear

  • Description. Drone CV + LIDAR analysis identifies vegetation at risk of feeder contact; correlate with weather forecast; recommend pre-emptive clearing crew dispatch.
  • Primary schema. GridML (Grid Asset, Wildfire Risk Zone).
  • Action invoked. Vegetation-crew dispatch with location; work-order creation.
  • Data used. Drone/LIDAR imagery, vegetation-growth model, weather forecast, historical contact patterns.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate (vegetation-manager approval on crew dispatch).
  • Trigger. Drone-survey results + weather-threshold.

ER-PU-ORCH-05 Outage Prediction + Pre-Positioning

  • Description. Predict likely outage zones given weather forecast + grid-asset health + vegetation status; recommend pre-positioning of crews and supplies.
  • Primary schema. GridML (Grid Asset, Outage Event history); related OutageML.
  • Action invoked. Crew pre-positioning instructions.
  • Data used. Weather forecast, asset-health model, historical outage patterns, vegetation status.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (operations director) on crew-movement decisions.
  • Trigger. Approaching weather event with forecasted impact.

ER-PU-ORCH-06 AMI Theft / Non-Technical-Loss Detection

  • Description. Pattern-detect anomalies in meter consumption vs peer cohort, weather-normalized demand, occupancy signals; flag potential theft or meter-tamper.
  • Primary schema. MeterML (Meter Read); related GridML.
  • Action invoked. Investigation case assignment to revenue-protection team.
  • Data used. Meter time-series, cohort baselines, weather-normalization, occupancy signals.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (revenue-protection investigator) before on-site action.
  • Trigger. Daily pattern-detection run.

ER-PU-ORCH-07 Customer Outage Communication Orchestration

  • Description. During outage event: personalize ETR messages per customer preferences; respond to inbound customer queries via automated + human channels; suppress duplicate messaging.
  • Primary schema. OutageML (Outage Event); related MeterML.
  • Action invoked. Multi-channel customer communication (SMS, email, app, voice).
  • Data used. Customer contact preferences, outage state, ETR estimates, channel deliverability.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (auto-exec within approved message library).
  • Trigger. Outage-state change requiring customer communication.

ER-PU-ORCH-08 Load Forecast + Demand Response Dispatch

  • Description. Day-ahead load forecast combining weather + economic activity + historical patterns; identify demand-response dispatch opportunities; execute across enrolled customers.
  • Primary schema. MeterML (Meter Read); related GridML (DER Unit).
  • Action invoked. Demand-response signals to enrolled customers; market settlement.
  • Data used. Load forecast model, enrollment registry, market prices, event triggers.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for routine; hard gate (load-forecasting manager) on novel conditions.
  • Trigger. Day-ahead forecast + market signal.

T.4.3 Mining (FleetML, OreBodyML) orchestrations

ER-MIN-ORCH-01 Fleet Dispatch Optimization

  • Description. Real-time haul-truck dispatch optimizing against shovel wait, route congestion, fuel/tire wear; continuous re-optimization as conditions change.
  • Primary schema. FleetML (Fleet Unit, Dispatch Event); related OreBodyML.
  • Action invoked. Dispatch assignments pushed to fleet-management system.
  • Data used. Fleet telematics, shovel position + cycle time, haul routes, ore-grade by cell.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (dispatch runs autonomously within approved rules; mine supervisor exceptions).
  • Trigger. Continuous fleet state + shovel load-completion events.

ER-MIN-ORCH-02 Ore-Body Reconciliation

  • Description. Compare planned ore grade (block model) against actual as-mined grade; detect reconciliation gaps; recommend plan updates or grade-control adjustments.
  • Primary schema. OreBodyML (Ore Body Cell); related FleetML.
  • Action invoked. Grade-control workflow; mine-plan-update trigger on material variance.
  • Data used. Block model, sampling assays, as-mined tonnages.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (mine-planning engineer).
  • Trigger. Daily reconciliation cycle.

ER-MIN-ORCH-03 Tailings-Dam Monitoring + Alert

  • Description. Continuous monitoring of tailings-dam instrumentation (piezometers, strainmeters, phreatic level); detect anomalous patterns; escalate per safety-critical response protocol.
  • Primary schema. AssetML (asset-generic adapted); related ProcessML.
  • Action invoked. Safety-engineering alert; operational hold on tailings-deposition if critical; regulatory notification.
  • Data used. Instrumentation time-series, historical-baseline, weather correlation.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (geotechnical engineer + safety director) on response actions; regulator notification required on critical.
  • Trigger. Instrumentation pattern crossing safety-envelope.

ER-MIN-ORCH-04 Equipment Health + Preventive Maintenance

  • Description. Per heavy-equipment unit: aggregate telematics + oil-analysis + vibration into health score; schedule preventive maintenance against production impact.
  • Primary schema. FleetML (Fleet Unit); related AssetML.
  • Action invoked. Maintenance work-order scheduling; parts-reservation.
  • Data used. Telematics, oil-analysis results, vibration signatures, maintenance-history.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for routine preventive; hard gate for extended-outage maintenance.
  • Trigger. Health-score-threshold OR scheduled cadence.

ER-MIN-ORCH-05 Energy Consumption Optimization

  • Description. Across mine operation: identify energy-intensive processes; recommend operational adjustments (comminution circuit, ventilation, haulage-elec conversion).
  • Primary schema. ProcessML; related FleetML.
  • Action invoked. Energy-efficiency recommendation package for operations review.
  • Data used. Energy submetering, process-throughput, energy-cost.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (operations + sustainability) on operational changes.
  • Trigger. Weekly energy-review cycle.

T.5 Industrial & Manufacturing (AXLE) Practice orchestrations

This section covers AXLEML sub-model orchestrations (APEX AXLE Practice — auto + aerospace + industrial products + discrete mfg). For the complementary AXLE framework's 10 automotive-specific orchestrations (ORCH-01 through ORCH-10) which operate on the 9 AXLE framework schemas (AAML, QEML, PDML, SCML, WOSFML, DTML, CVML, ESML, WLML), cross-reference §12.9 "AXLE Framework vs APEX AXLE Practice (AXLEML)." The AXLE framework orchestrations include: Real-Time OEE Optimization (ORCH-01/AAML), Predictive Maintenance Dispatch (ORCH-02/PDML), Downtime Root-Cause Analysis (ORCH-03/AAML), Quality Escape Prevention (ORCH-04/QEML), Warranty-to-Plant Feedback Loop (ORCH-05/WLML), Supply Chain Disruption Response (ORCH-06/SCML), Workforce Rotation Optimization (ORCH-07/WOSFML), Digital Twin Scenario Evaluation (ORCH-08/DTML), Energy Consumption Optimization (ORCH-09/ESML), Connected Vehicle Fleet Intelligence (ORCH-10/CVML).

T.5.1 AXLEML Product sub-model orchestrations

AXLE-PROD-ORCH-01 Engineering Change Order (ECO) Impact Analysis

  • Description. On ECO submission: resolve downstream impact across active work-orders, inventory, in-field units, supplier tooling; simulate cutover options; recommend effective-date + disposition.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Product (Item, BOM, ECO); related AXLEML Manufacturing, Aftermarket.
  • Action invoked. Cutover plan proposal; supplier-notification prep; in-field-update trigger (if applicable).
  • Data used. BOM explosion, Work-Order state, Inventory position, installed-base registry, ECO impact model.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (change-control board).
  • Trigger. ECO submission in PLM.
  • Archetype. "Change-propagation with impact simulation and stakeholder approval."

AXLE-PROD-ORCH-02 Generative Engineering Design-Space Exploration

  • Description. For new product feature: orchestrate CAD seed → simulation sweep (Ansys/Siemens NX/Altair) → topology optimisation → manufacturing-feasibility check → regulatory-check; produce ranked candidates for engineering review.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Product (Item, Configuration); related AXLEML Manufacturing.
  • Action invoked. Candidate-design package for Chief Engineer review.
  • Data used. Engineering constraints, simulation parameters, manufacturing capabilities, regulatory rules.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Chief Engineer + specialist review).
  • Trigger. Product-program initiation.

AXLE-PROD-ORCH-03 Configuration Validation

  • Description. On configurable-product order: validate configuration against constraint model; check buildability; price per configuration rules.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Product (Configuration, Item).
  • Action invoked. Valid-configuration confirmation with price; rejection with feedback on invalid configurations.
  • Data used. Configuration rules, pricing model, buildability constraints.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (routine); hard gate for exception configurations.
  • Trigger. CPQ configuration submission.

T.5.2 AXLEML Manufacturing sub-model orchestrations

AXLE-MFG-ORCH-01 OEE Optimization + Bottleneck Resolution

  • Description. Real-time OEE monitoring; detect bottleneck station/line; diagnose root cause (equipment, quality, operator); recommend corrective action. (AXLE framework ORCH-01 equivalent for APEX Practice scope.)
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Manufacturing (Work Order, Operation, Equipment); related Quality sub-model.
  • Action invoked. Corrective action recommendation to plant supervisor.
  • Data used. MES operation stream, equipment telemetry, quality-event data.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for minor; hard gate (plant supervisor) on station-stop.
  • Trigger. Continuous OEE monitoring + threshold.

AXLE-MFG-ORCH-02 Predictive Maintenance Scheduling

  • Description. Per manufacturing-equipment unit: predict failure from vibration + motor-current + oil-analysis; schedule maintenance against production calendar; confirm parts + technicians.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Manufacturing (Equipment); related Product sub-model.
  • Action invoked. Work-order creation + parts/tech scheduling.
  • Data used. Equipment telemetry, historian-derived health model, production schedule.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for routine; hard gate for production-impact.
  • Trigger. Health-threshold crossing.

AXLE-MFG-ORCH-03 Quality Event Correlation + Root Cause

  • Description. On quality event: correlate across upstream manufacturing conditions (material lot, setpoints, operator, shift, equipment state) to identify likely root cause.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Manufacturing + Quality (Work Order, Operation, Quality Event); related Aftermarket (Part Genealogy).
  • Action invoked. Root-cause hypothesis for quality engineer; containment recommendation for affected units.
  • Data used. Operation trace, material lot, setpoint history, operator assignment.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (quality engineer) on containment.
  • Trigger. Quality event detection.

AXLE-MFG-ORCH-04 Material Supply Risk Response

  • Description. Detect impending material shortage (tier-n supplier disruption signal + current inventory + upcoming work-order demand); recommend mitigation (alternative supplier, expedite, reschedule).
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Manufacturing + Supply; related Product.
  • Action invoked. Mitigation-plan proposal for supply and production coordination.
  • Data used. Supplier risk signals, inventory, planned work-order demand.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (supply manager + production planner).
  • Trigger. Supplier-risk signal or inventory-threshold.

T.5.3 AXLEML Aftermarket sub-model orchestrations

AXLE-AFT-ORCH-01 Warranty-Pattern Correlation to Manufacturing

  • Description. Aggregate field warranty claims; correlate via part genealogy to manufacturing lots; identify emerging systemic issues before field failures cascade.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Aftermarket (Warranty Claim, Service Record, Part Genealogy); related Manufacturing.
  • Action invoked. Warranty-pattern investigation case for warranty engineering; supplier-recovery trigger if traceable.
  • Data used. Warranty claims, service records, lot genealogy, manufacturing records.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (warranty engineering + quality).
  • Trigger. Continuous warranty-pattern detection.
  • Archetype. "Field-signal pattern-match to upstream manufacturing with root-cause attribution."

AXLE-AFT-ORCH-02 Field Service Campaign Execution

  • Description. On confirmed field-issue pattern: scope affected units via Part Genealogy; draft customer communication; coordinate dealer dispatch; track remediation progress.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Aftermarket (Service Record, Part Genealogy); related Connected.
  • Action invoked. Customer notification; dealer dispatch; remediation tracking.
  • Data used. Installed-base registry, field-issue scope, dealer capacity.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (campaign manager + Legal) before customer notification.
  • Trigger. Field-issue scoping completion + campaign-authorisation.

AXLE-AFT-ORCH-03 Predictive Service Recommendation

  • Description. Per in-service unit: combine telematics + utilization + maintenance-history; predict next-service need; recommend service to unit owner via dealer channel.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Aftermarket + Connected (Service Record, Telemetry).
  • Action invoked. Service recommendation delivered to dealer + owner.
  • Data used. Unit telematics, utilization profile, maintenance history.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (dealer accepts or modifies recommendation).
  • Trigger. Continuous monitoring + service-window detection.

T.5.4 AXLEML Connected sub-model orchestrations

AXLE-CONN-ORCH-01 DTC Cluster Detection + Campaign Trigger

  • Description. Monitor diagnostic-trouble-code (DTC) stream across fleet; detect emerging clusters by make/model/year/build-window; recommend TSB (technical service bulletin) or campaign.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Connected (Telemetry, DTC Event); related Aftermarket.
  • Action invoked. TSB/campaign trigger workflow.
  • Data used. DTC telemetry, fleet build-data, field-issue-precedent library.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (engineering + quality) on TSB/campaign initiation.
  • Trigger. Continuous DTC-cluster detection.

AXLE-CONN-ORCH-02 OTA Deployment Canary Evaluation

  • Description. For OTA software rollout: monitor canary cohort telemetry pre/post deployment; evaluate regression signals; decide next cohort vs rollback.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Connected (OTA Deployment, Telemetry).
  • Action invoked. Next-cohort expansion OR rollback.
  • Data used. Canary-cohort telemetry pre/post, regression-evaluation criteria.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (OTA manager + engineering) on expansion/rollback.
  • Trigger. Canary-cohort evaluation window completion.

AXLE-CONN-ORCH-03 Connected-Fleet Utilization Analytics

  • Description. Aggregate fleet-wide utilization patterns; identify outlier units (under-utilized, abused, anomalous); recommend actions by unit owner / fleet manager.
  • Primary schema. AXLEML Connected.
  • Action invoked. Utilization reports to fleet customers; intervention recommendations.
  • Data used. Telemetry across fleet, utilisation-profile baselines.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (standard reports auto); hard gate on intervention recommendations.
  • Trigger. Scheduled fleet-analytics cycle.

T.6 Technology, Media & Telecom (TMT) Practice orchestrations

T.6.1 TMT-TEC (DeveloperML, ProductUsageML) orchestrations

TMT-TEC-ORCH-01 Developer Productivity Agent-Assist

  • Description. In IDE / code-review context: suggest code improvements, flag security patterns, recommend test additions, summarize PR context for reviewers.
  • Primary schema. TEC DeveloperML (Developer, Code Artifact).
  • Action invoked. In-IDE suggestions; PR-comment drafts.
  • Data used. Code artifact, developer history, PR context, security-pattern library.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (developer accepts suggestions; reviewer accepts comments).
  • Trigger. Developer IDE session or PR-creation event.

TMT-TEC-ORCH-02 Product-Usage Churn-Risk Prediction

  • Description. Per customer: evaluate product-usage trajectory; identify declining-engagement patterns; trigger retention-intervention workflow.
  • Primary schema. TEC ProductUsageML (Product Usage Event).
  • Action invoked. Customer-success-manager alert with retention-offer recommendations.
  • Data used. Product telemetry, support-ticket history, customer-success touchpoints.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (CSM approves intervention).
  • Trigger. Continuous trajectory monitoring + threshold.

TMT-TEC-ORCH-03 Support Case Intelligence + Resolution-Assist

  • Description. On new support case: classify intent, retrieve similar prior cases, recommend resolution steps, draft response for agent review.
  • Primary schema. TEC ProductUsageML; related DeveloperML.
  • Action invoked. Case-routing + resolution-assist surface in agent console.
  • Data used. Case text, KB articles, prior-case patterns.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (agent reviews drafts before customer-facing response).
  • Trigger. New support case.

TMT-TEC-ORCH-04 Internal Knowledge-Query Orchestration

  • Description. Employee queries across enterprise knowledge (docs, wikis, prior discussions); return grounded answer with citations; route unanswered to SME.
  • Primary schema. TEC (ProductUsageML as proxy for employee engagement).
  • Action invoked. Answer delivery via Copilot surface; SME escalation if unanswered.
  • Data used. Enterprise knowledge corpus, SME-routing map.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (Copilot answers auto); hard gate on SME escalations.
  • Trigger. Employee query submission.

T.6.2 TMT-MED (ContentML, AudienceML, RightsML) orchestrations

TMT-MED-ORCH-01 Cross-Channel Personalization

  • Description. Per viewer: score content-recommendation candidates across channels; respect rights-window constraints; orchestrate across streaming platforms for coherent experience.
  • Primary schema. MED ContentML + AudienceML + RightsML.
  • Action invoked. Recommendation delivery to viewer-surface; engagement-tracking for model refinement.
  • Data used. Audience Cohort profile, Viewing Event history, Content metadata, Rights Window.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within editorial policy); hard gate for new-content placement.
  • Trigger. Viewer session start.

TMT-MED-ORCH-02 Content-Production Workflow Optimization

  • Description. Non-creative production coordination: scheduling, clearance tracking, post-production handoff, talent-availability; surface workflow friction.
  • Primary schema. MED ContentML (Title, Episode).
  • Action invoked. Production-schedule adjustments; bottleneck alerts.
  • Data used. Production schedule, talent + resource availability, clearance status.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (production-coordinator).
  • Trigger. Schedule-variance detection or daily production-review cycle.

TMT-MED-ORCH-03 Rights-Window Utilization + Expansion

  • Description. Monitor rights portfolio utilization; identify under-utilized windows; recommend additional-territory licensing or new-platform exposure.
  • Primary schema. MED RightsML (Rights Window, Title).
  • Action invoked. Licensing-opportunity package for rights team.
  • Data used. Rights inventory, utilization telemetry, licensing-market signals.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (rights team).
  • Trigger. Rights-window approaching expiration + under-utilization.

TMT-MED-ORCH-04 Ad-Yield Optimization

  • Description. Real-time ad-inventory yield management: match advertiser demand to audience-inventory at optimal clearing price; respect brand-safety constraints.
  • Primary schema. MED AudienceML.
  • Action invoked. Ad-placement decisions in programmatic exchange.
  • Data used. Ad-demand signals, audience-inventory, brand-safety rules, historical yield.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within rules); hard gate for high-value or anomalous placements.
  • Trigger. Ad-inventory request.

TMT-MED-ORCH-05 Voice-of-Audience Pattern Detection

  • Description. Aggregate social + engagement + churn signals; detect emerging audience-sentiment patterns; feed product and content teams.
  • Primary schema. MED AudienceML.
  • Action invoked. Pattern report delivery to product and content strategy teams.
  • Data used. Social signals, engagement metrics, cancellation-reason analytics.
  • HITL pattern. Soft gate (analytics lead review).
  • Trigger. Daily pattern-detection cycle.

T.6.3 TMT-TEL (NetworkML, SubscriberML, ServiceML) orchestrations

TMT-TEL-ORCH-01 Network Incident Triage

  • Description. On alarm cluster: correlate across network elements; rank probable root causes; recommend remediation; minimize false-positive analyst fatigue.
  • Primary schema. TEL NetworkML (Alarm, Network Element); related SubscriberML.
  • Action invoked. Recommendation to NOC analyst with remediation steps.
  • Data used. Alarm stream, topology, known-issue patterns, subscriber-impact estimate.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (NOC analyst confirms root cause + authorizes remediation).
  • Trigger. Alarm cluster crossing threshold.

TMT-TEL-ORCH-02 Truck-Roll Avoidance

  • Description. Pre-dispatch diagnosis: customer-reported issue + network-element telemetry + device-state signals; determine if remotely resolvable; dispatch only if necessary.
  • Primary schema. TEL NetworkML + ServiceML + SubscriberML.
  • Action invoked. Remote resolution OR truck-dispatch decision.
  • Data used. Customer issue report, network telemetry, device-diagnostic data.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for remote resolution; hard gate for dispatch.
  • Trigger. Customer service request.

TMT-TEL-ORCH-03 Churn-Risk Intervention

  • Description. Identify subscribers at churn risk (usage decline, service issues, payment friction, competitor moves); orchestrate multi-channel retention outreach.
  • Primary schema. TEL SubscriberML; related ServiceML.
  • Action invoked. Retention offer via preferred channel.
  • Data used. Subscriber 360, churn-propensity model, offer-eligibility.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within retention-offer library); hard gate for high-value or novel offers.
  • Trigger. Daily churn-risk detection.

TMT-TEL-ORCH-04 BSS Order Exception Resolution

  • Description. Detect stuck / incomplete service orders; diagnose cause (provisioning, billing, dependency); orchestrate resolution across systems.
  • Primary schema. TEL ServiceML (Service); related SubscriberML.
  • Action invoked. Order-resolution workflow across BSS components.
  • Data used. Order state across BSS modules, dependency map, resolution-playbook library.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (customer-ops specialist) on resolution execution.
  • Trigger. Order-stuck detection.

TMT-TEL-ORCH-05 Fraud Pattern Detection

  • Description. Detect anomalous subscriber behavior patterns (porting fraud, usage fraud, account-takeover); investigate with evidence assembly.
  • Primary schema. TEL SubscriberML.
  • Action invoked. Fraud investigation case with evidence; pre-payment hold on high-confidence.
  • Data used. Subscriber behavior, device signals, payment patterns.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (fraud investigator) before action.
  • Trigger. Continuous pattern detection.

TMT-TEL-ORCH-06 B2B Enterprise-Customer Commercial Effectiveness

  • Description. Per B2B customer: surface next-best-action combining service performance, contract expiration, growth signals, competitive landscape.
  • Primary schema. TEL SubscriberML (B2B) + ServiceML.
  • Action invoked. NBA to enterprise-account rep.
  • Data used. Customer 360 across CRM + BSS + network performance.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (account rep accepts).
  • Trigger. Account-planning cycle or event-trigger.

TMT-TEL-ORCH-07 CPNI-Compliance Enforcement in Customer Interaction

  • Description. During customer interaction: enforce CPNI handling rules on data visibility to agent; audit every access; flag training gaps.
  • Primary schema. TEL SubscriberML.
  • Action invoked. Access-control enforcement in agent desktop; training-flag on policy violation patterns.
  • Data used. CPNI classification, agent-role authorization, interaction context.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within compliance envelope); hard gate on elevated access.
  • Trigger. Customer interaction start.

T.7 Travel & Hospitality (TH) Practice orchestrations

T.7.1 TravelerML orchestrations

TH-TRAV-ORCH-01 Traveler Identity Resolution Across Systems

  • Description. Resolve ambiguous traveler identifiers across PSS, PMS, loyalty, ops systems to canonical traveler; low-confidence matches route to HITL.
  • Primary schema. TravelerML (Traveler, Identity).
  • Action invoked. Canonical-identity assignment OR ambiguity-review task.
  • Data used. Source-system identifiers, historical merges, evidence patterns.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for high-confidence; hard gate (loyalty-ops) for ambiguous.
  • Trigger. New identity record OR explicit resolution request.

TH-TRAV-ORCH-02 Pre-Arrival Personalization

  • Description. Before traveler arrival (flight/stay/trip): aggregate preferences + past-behavior + journey context; deliver personalized context to service staff and pre-arrival communications to traveler.
  • Primary schema. TravelerML (Traveler, Preference, Journey).
  • Action invoked. Staff pre-arrival briefing; traveler communication.
  • Data used. Traveler 360, Journey specifics, loyalty status.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate.
  • Trigger. Journey-approach threshold (e.g., 24h pre-arrival).

T.7.2 OpsML orchestrations

TH-OPS-ORCH-01 IROPs Disruption-Recovery Re-accommodation

  • Description. On IROPs event (weather, mech, crew, ATC): scope impact (flights + travelers + crew); generate re-accommodation plans per traveler tier; orchestrate communication + re-booking + compensation.
  • Primary schema. OpsML (Flight, Disruption Event, Re-accommodation); related TravelerML + LoyaltyML.
  • Action invoked. Re-booking execution; compensation vouchers; proactive communication.
  • Data used. Flight network state, crew availability, partner-carrier space, loyalty-value tiering.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (ops controller + crew scheduler + comms lead).
  • Trigger. IROPs event declaration.
  • Archetype. "Large-scale disruption with multi-stakeholder recovery + tiered-response."

TH-OPS-ORCH-02 Crew-Legality Recovery

  • Description. In IROPs: identify crew-pairing rotations that break duty limits; generate union-contract-compliant alternatives (reserve call, swap, cancel-cover); present scheduler.
  • Primary schema. OpsML (Flight, Crew).
  • Action invoked. Crew reassignment post-approval.
  • Data used. Crew-schedule state, union contract rules, reserve-crew availability.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (crew scheduler + union liaison where applicable).
  • Trigger. IROPs event + duty-limit check.

TH-OPS-ORCH-03 DOT Tarmac-Rule Exposure Prevention

  • Description. Monitor held-on-taxiway flights approaching DOT thresholds; flag at 2:15; recommend action (return-to-gate, offload, re-board) before threshold crossed.
  • Primary schema. OpsML (Flight, Gate Event).
  • Action invoked. Ops-controller alert with recommended action.
  • Data used. Flight state (on-taxiway time, passenger count, weather clearance status).
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (ops controller).
  • Trigger. Tarmac-hold time-approaching-threshold detection.

TH-OPS-ORCH-04 Gate-Turn Optimization

  • Description. Per gate turn: optimize ramp-resource sequencing (fuel + catering + cleaning + cargo) against tight-turn window.
  • Primary schema. OpsML (Flight, Gate Event).
  • Action invoked. Ramp-team task sequencing.
  • Data used. Aircraft arrival, resource availability, scheduled departure.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within operations rules).
  • Trigger. Aircraft on-gate event.

TH-OPS-ORCH-05 Proactive-Communications During Event

  • Description. During IROPs or service disruption: drive tiered customer communication respecting preferences; suppress duplicate messaging; escalate to live-agent for high-value travelers.
  • Primary schema. OpsML (Disruption Event); related TravelerML.
  • Action invoked. Multi-channel customer communication.
  • Data used. Traveler preferences, journey state, disruption scope.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within approved message library); hard gate for high-value escalation.
  • Trigger. Disruption event.

T.7.3 LoyaltyML + RevenueML orchestrations

TH-LOY-ORCH-01 Loyalty Earning Reconciliation

  • Description. Daily reconciliation of partner-earnings (airline + hotel + credit-card + retail); detect variance; route anomalies for investigation.
  • Primary schema. LoyaltyML (Loyalty Member, Earning Event).
  • Action invoked. Partner-settlement adjustments; fraud-investigation flag on anomalies.
  • Data used. Partner earning feeds, loyalty ledger, historical patterns.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for matching; hard gate (loyalty-ops) on variance.
  • Trigger. Nightly reconciliation job.

TH-LOY-ORCH-02 Loyalty-Member Retention Campaign

  • Description. Identify at-risk loyalty members; design personalized retention offer; execute and track response.
  • Primary schema. LoyaltyML (Loyalty Member).
  • Action invoked. Retention offer via preferred channel.
  • Data used. Member LTV, engagement trajectory, offer-eligibility rules.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (library offers); hard gate for high-tier.
  • Trigger. At-risk detection.

TH-REV-ORCH-01 Dynamic Fare / Rate Adjustment

  • Description. Per market pair (airline) or property-night (hotel): evaluate demand signals + competitive prices + inventory remaining; recommend fare / rate adjustments.
  • Primary schema. RevenueML (Fare Ladder, Yield Signal).
  • Action invoked. Fare / rate change post-HITL.
  • Data used. Booking pace, competitive prices, inventory state, market-specific model.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within rate-management policy); hard gate (RM team) on novel moves.
  • Trigger. Continuous yield monitoring.

T.8 Industrial & Commercial Equipment (ICE) Practice orchestrations

T.8.1 EquipmentML + DealerML orchestrations

ICE-EQUIP-ORCH-01 Connected-Equipment Health Analytics

  • Description. Per unit: aggregate telematics into health score; detect emerging-failure patterns; recommend service to unit owner via dealer.
  • Primary schema. EquipmentML (Unit, Telemetry Event).
  • Action invoked. Service recommendation to dealer.
  • Data used. Telematics, utilization profile, service history.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate; dealer accepts or modifies.
  • Trigger. Continuous health monitoring + threshold.

ICE-EQUIP-ORCH-02 Predictive-Parts-Stocking per Dealer

  • Description. Forecast parts demand per dealer per region; optimize stocking levels against stockout-avoidance + capital efficiency.
  • Primary schema. EquipmentML + AftermarketML (Part Demand Signal).
  • Action invoked. Stocking-level recommendations to dealer network.
  • Data used. Installed base, predictive-service signals, historical parts usage.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within-range); hard gate on high-value or anomalous.
  • Trigger. Weekly parts-planning cycle.

ICE-DLR-ORCH-01 Dealer Performance Benchmarking + Coaching

  • Description. Per dealer: compute performance against peer cohort; identify improvement opportunities; recommend targeted coaching.
  • Primary schema. DealerML (Dealer, Performance Metric, Territory).
  • Action invoked. Coaching-engagement with dealer-development manager.
  • Data used. Dealer performance across dimensions, peer-cohort benchmarks.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (dealer-development manager).
  • Trigger. Quarterly dealer-review cycle.

ICE-DLR-ORCH-02 Dealer-OEM Data-Contract Compliance

  • Description. Enforce contractual data-sharing boundaries in every agent's access to dealer data; audit access; flag violations.
  • Primary schema. DealerML (Dealer-OEM Data Contract).
  • Action invoked. Access enforcement; violation-flag with legal review.
  • Data used. Contract terms by dealer, agent access patterns.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within-contract); hard gate on boundary.
  • Trigger. Continuous access evaluation.

T.8.2 AftermarketML + RentalML orchestrations

ICE-AFT-ORCH-01 Warranty-Claim Processing + Supplier Recovery

  • Description. Process warranty claims; correlate to manufacturing + supplier; identify supplier-recovery candidates; execute recovery workflow.
  • Primary schema. AftermarketML (Warranty Claim, Service Record); related Manufacturing (part lineage).
  • Action invoked. Claim processing; supplier-recovery case.
  • Data used. Warranty claims, part genealogy, supplier terms.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate for routine; hard gate for supplier-recovery escalation.
  • Trigger. Warranty claim submission.

ICE-AFT-ORCH-02 Aftermarket-Programme Attach Opportunity

  • Description. Identify units whose age + usage + service history indicates aftermarket-programme fit (extended warranty, service contract, connected-service); route to dealer for owner engagement.
  • Primary schema. AftermarketML (Attach Opportunity); related EquipmentML.
  • Action invoked. Dealer-engagement workflow with owner.
  • Data used. Installed base, utilization, life-cycle stage, programme eligibility.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (dealer executes); hard gate if customer-segment anomalous.
  • Trigger. Monthly attach-opportunity identification.

ICE-RENT-ORCH-01 Rental-Fleet Utilization Optimization

  • Description. Across rental fleet: detect under-utilized units in one location + demand in another; propose redeployment; balance against transfer cost.
  • Primary schema. RentalML (Rental Asset, Utilisation Window).
  • Action invoked. Rental-asset redeployment plan.
  • Data used. Utilization across locations, forward-demand forecast, transfer-cost model.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (rental-fleet manager).
  • Trigger. Weekly fleet-balance review.

ICE-RENT-ORCH-02 Dynamic Rental Rate Adjustment

  • Description. Per rental market: evaluate competitive rates + demand pace + fleet utilization; recommend rate adjustments.
  • Primary schema. RentalML (Pricing Signal, Rental Asset).
  • Action invoked. Rate-change post-HITL.
  • Data used. Competitive-rate intelligence, booking pace, utilization.
  • HITL pattern. Policy gate (within-band); hard gate for novel.
  • Trigger. Continuous market-signal monitoring.

T.9 Cross-Practice orchestrations

These orchestrations span multiple Practice schemas — required for diversified-industrial clients or multi-Practice deployments. Cross-Practice orchestrations federate canonical entities across Practice boundaries under trust-envelope enforcement.

XP-ORCH-01 Cross-Practice Identity Federation

  • Description. When a single person appears as Customer (RC), Traveler (TH), Subscriber (TMT-TEL), Member (HLS) across Practices: resolve to canonical cross-Practice identity with Practice-specific attribute inheritance.
  • Primary schemas. Multi-schema federation.
  • Action invoked. Cross-Practice canonical identity assignment with scope boundaries preserved.
  • Data used. Per-Practice identity records, consent records, cross-Practice federation rules.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Privacy + data-governance team) on federation approval.
  • Trigger. Cross-Practice query or explicit resolution request.

XP-ORCH-02 Cross-Practice Audit Trail Consolidation

  • Description. For regulatory inquiry touching multiple Practices: assemble consolidated audit trail from per-Practice audit-row systems; preserve classification; produce regulator-ready evidence.
  • Primary schemas. Audit-row streams across Practices.
  • Action invoked. Consolidated evidence-package generation.
  • Data used. Per-Practice audit rows, lineage, classification records.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (General Counsel + Compliance) on release.
  • Trigger. Regulator inquiry OR internal-compliance triggered audit.

XP-ORCH-03 Cross-Practice Classification-Change Propagation

  • Description. When classification taxonomy updates (new regulation, reclassification): propagate to every dependent schema and ensure downstream agents + tools enforce consistently.
  • Primary schemas. All Practice schemas.
  • Action invoked. Classification-update deployment; validation across dependent artifacts; agent-manifest update as needed.
  • Data used. Purview classification definitions, schema dependencies, agent manifests.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (Data governance + Compliance).
  • Trigger. Classification-policy change OR regulatory update.

XP-ORCH-04 Cross-Practice Incident-Scope Federation

  • Description. When incident touches multiple Practices (e.g., workplace incident affecting employee who is also customer; product-quality issue in automotive that touches retail dealer): federate scope computation across Practices.
  • Primary schemas. Multi-schema.
  • Action invoked. Consolidated scope + coordinated notifications across Practices.
  • Data used. Practice-specific incident systems, federation rules.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (incident commander + per-Practice representatives).
  • Trigger. Cross-Practice incident detection.

XP-ORCH-05 Cross-Practice KPI Aggregation for Board Reporting

  • Description. For enterprise board reporting: aggregate per-Practice KPIs with attribution; produce consolidated AI-program value summary; preserve per-Practice drilldown.
  • Primary schemas. Per-Practice audit rows + KPIs.
  • Action invoked. Board-ready reporting package.
  • Data used. Per-Practice KPIs, audit-row attribution, enterprise aggregation rules.
  • HITL pattern. Hard gate (CFO + AI-program lead).
  • Trigger. Board-reporting cycle.

T.10 The 47 Pattern Decomposition — Archetype → Orchestration Cross-Reference

The 47 APEX reusable orchestration archetypes manifest across the 150+ Practice-specific orchestrations catalogued above. This section maps each archetype to the specific orchestrations in this catalog that instantiate it — so readers can see every orchestration's archetype membership via this cross-reference table, and so Wave 2 scoping conversations can count archetype-specialization effort directly.
